name: App Grade
passDefinition: A valid grade of B, A, or S counts as a pass.

tiers.F: The production build was not served, or a floor check failed.
tiers.U: The production build was served. No floor check failed, but a floor check could not be measured.
tiers.C: A journey check failed or a non-integrity review was refuted, after the build and floor checks avoided F and U.
tiers.B: The build was served. No floor check failed or remained unmeasured. No journey check failed and no non-integrity review was refuted. At least one such review remains unresolved, or an installation, typecheck, build, or test gate is incomplete.
tiers.A: All non-integrity reviews are supported, and installation, typecheck, build, and tests pass. Some declared coverage remains unmeasured or not applicable.
tiers.S: All those review and engineering gates pass, with no declared unmeasured or not-applicable checks.

integrityRule: A failed integrity check or supported integrity concern marks the grade invalid. Invalid grades require human review and do not count as passes.
measurementBasis: Stored deterministic checks, stored model review assessments, and engineering gates determine the tier. The tiers are not a weighted score.
scope: This is a reader summary of the grader used for these reports. Individual task prompts define the requested behavior.
